columns.name: CHANGE_COMPONENT_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier

columns.name: CHANGE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Change Instance

columns.name: PHYSICAL_TYPE
columns.description: Indication that the component contains physical record changes

columns.name: LOGICAL_TYPE
columns.description: Indication that the component contains logical record changes

columns.name: VALIDATION_START_DATE
columns.description: For DE entities the Validation Start Date of the affected change

columns.name: VALIDATION_END_DATE
columns.description: For DE entities the Validation End Date of the affected change

columns.name: OLD_EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Effective Start Date old value

columns.name: NEW_EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Effective Start Date new value

columns.name: OLD_EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Effective End Date old value

columns.name: NEW_EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Effective End Date new value

columns.name: OLD_SEQUENCE
columns.description: The old sequence number of the changed record in the case of Multiple Changes per Day

columns.name: NEW_SEQUENCE
columns.description: The new sequence number of the changed record in the case of Multiple Changes per Day

columns.name: CHANGE_ATTRS
columns.description: Changed Attributes stored in the form of name and values

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
